summary: Expand the fixed-token cleanup through the plant supervisor, plant CLI, setup guides, and PowerShell launchers. Stop printing or forwarding tokens in process arguments; use the configured runtime environment instead and keep startup refusal fail-closed.
evidence: Independent read-only review found Icarus plant CLI/supervisor startup banners and subprocess argv also expose configured token values.
Active launch helpers include Bash and PowerShell paths that still inject or display a fixed token; Icarus-engine has a separate PowerShell launcher and uses a legacy admin-token environment name.
next_action: Inspect each active launch path and its tests, then use one documented `ICARUS_TOKEN` environment variable for child processes without putting values in argv or output.
